title: ActionCarrier
description: A morphism, as data: a registered boundary morphism — a cocone leg — over the package carrier. This is the schema-described, serializable face of an action; the executable `run` is the process boundary (the cut), not part of the morphism's data identity, so it is not a property here. `domainSchema`/`codomainSchema` are JSON Schemas (typically a single `$ref` to a carrier `$id`, resolved through the schema registry) naming the morphism's domain and codomain carriers; `inputFormat`/`outputFormat` name the wire codecs on each side.

domainSchema.description: A JSON Schema for the domain carrier; typically { "$ref": "<carrier $id>" }. An opaque schema document — any JSON Schema (object or boolean).

codomainSchema.description: A JSON Schema for the codomain carrier; typically { "$ref": "<carrier $id>" }. An opaque schema document — any JSON Schema (object or boolean).
